description: Complete Add Listing Wizard (ADD-01 through ADD-07) enhancements: improve category selector with search/tree, add listing type selector (For Sale/For Rent/Wanted), DynamicForm with category-driven EAV attributes, drag-drop media uploader with reorder and cover selection, price/location/contact entry, review page with quality score meter, and published confirmation with share buttons. Wizard must persist state to localStorage and maintain form state across step navigation.
steps: 1. Improve ADD-01 (Choose category tree): create searchable category selector with category search input, category tree display (13 categories expandable to subcategories), highlight matches, 'Other' option at bottom, selected category chip display.
2. Add ADD-02 (Listing type): radio buttons or chips for For Sale / For Rent / Wanted; icons for each; type affects pricing (e.g., rent shows perMonth toggle).

3. Enhance ADD-03 (Details): implement DynamicForm component that renders fields based on category schema from getFields(); field types: text, number, select, checkbox, date; required fields marked with *; validation on field blur.

4. Create ADD-04 (Media uploader) as full component: drag-drop zone + file picker button, image preview grid (3-4 columns), drag-to-reorder via GripVertical icon, delete (X) button per image, star icon to set cover image, cover badge overlay, progress bar per upload (mock), max 8 images, support for video (Video icon toggle, placeholder for URL input).
5. Implement ADD-05 (Price & Location): PriceInput + negotiable toggle, LocationPicker (city dropdown filtered to sudanCities, area dropdown filtered by city), optional phone contact field.

6. Add ADD-06 (Review & Publish): full preview card showing cover image, title, price, location, description snippet; quality score meter (0-100% calculated from completeness), terms checkbox, publish button, save draft button.

7. Add ADD-07 (Published confirmation): success animation (fade-in card), listing title + ref, success message, share buttons (Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, copy link), 'View Listing' button → /listing/:id, 'Add Another' button → reset form and return to step 0.

8. Enhance state persistence: extend DRAFT_KEY to auto-save on every field change (debounced 500ms), load draft on mount, include all steps 0-6, show 'Saved Locally' / 'Uploading' / 'Saved' sync status indicator at top right.
9. Ensure offline support: show 'Waiting for Connection' if networkState === 'offline', disable publish button, show alert bar below photos step.
10. Complete step navigation: forward/back buttons between all steps, disable next if required fields missing, validate before advancing (e.g., no empty title for step 2→3).
11. Fix completeness score calculation: include all required fields (title, description, price, location, photos, category specs), show progress bar + missing field hints.
12. Implement breadcrumb-style step indicator: show all 7 steps at top with progress, completed steps show checkmark + green bg, current step is highlighted with ring, future steps are gray.
acceptance_criteria: ADD-01 category selector renders 13 categories, search input filters by name, subcategories expand/collapse, 'Other' available.
ADD-02 shows For Sale / For Rent / Wanted options; selecting Rent shows perMonth toggle in price field later.
ADD-03 DynamicForm renders fields per category schema; fields validate on blur (required, type validation); spec values saved to state.

ADD-04 media uploader: drag-drop zone accepts images, file picker opens browser dialog, grid shows previews, drag-to-reorder works (GripVertical visible on hover), delete (X) removes image, star sets cover, cover badge shows, max 8 enforced, video toggle available.
ADD-05 price field validates numbers, negotiable toggle toggles checkbox, LocationPicker city dropdown filters, area dropdown filters by city, phone field accepts +249 format.
ADD-06 preview shows cover image, title, price, location, description (truncated); quality meter ranges 0-100 and updates on field changes; publish and save draft buttons functional.
ADD-07 shows success card with listing ref, share buttons open intents/copy, 'View Listing' navigates to detail, 'Add Another' resets.
Sync indicator shows 'Saved Locally' (default), 'Waiting for Connection' (offline), 'Uploading' (mock), 'Saved' (success).
Offline bar appears below photo step when offline; publish disabled.
Back/next buttons respect step bounds; disable next if required fields missing (title, description, price, photos, category spec requirements).
Completeness bar shows 0-100%; hints below bar show missing fields.
Step indicator shows all 7 steps; completed=checkmark+green, current=ring, future=gray; navigation via step click not implemented (sequential only).
verification: npm run typecheck — no errors in AddListingPage, DynamicForm component.
npm run dev — navigate to /add-listing; verify step indicator renders 7 steps, completeness 0%.
Step 0 (Intent): select 'For Sale', advance to step 1.
Step 1 (Category): search 'vehicle', select 'Vehicles', subcategories expand, select 'Cars', advance to step 2.
Step 2 (Details): verify vehicle fields (Make, Model, Year, etc.) render; fill title, advance to step 3.
Step 3 (Media): drag image onto zone or click picker, add 3 images, drag to reorder, click star on 2nd image (set cover), verify cover badge shows.
Step 4 (Price): enter 50000, toggle negotiable, select city Khartoum, select area, verify price field + location dropdowns work.
Step 5 (Review): verify preview shows all entered data, quality meter shows ≥ 50%, click publish → step 6 (confirmation).
Step 6 (Confirmation): verify success card, share buttons (mock toast), 'View Listing' and 'Add Another' buttons functional.
Refresh page → draft loads from localStorage; verify all form data persists.
Toggle offline (DevTools Network), attempt publish → offline alert appears, publish disabled.
Switch AR → all text translates, layout mirrors (flex, text-align, icon direction).
